parrafo_1.es: Pop's Food Bus es un food truck de BBQ que recorre Fort Lauderdale, FL los viernes y sábados. Las costillas se ahuman a fuego lento y se terminan con la salsa BBQ de mostaza propia de la casa.
parrafo_1.en: Pop's Food Bus is a mobile BBQ food truck serving Fort Lauderdale, FL on Fridays and Saturdays. Ribs are smoked low and slow and finished with Pop's own tangy mustard BBQ sauce.

parrafo_2.es: 45 reseñas en Google respaldan al camion, con las costillas y el sandwich de costilla como los platos mas pedidos del menu.
parrafo_2.en: 45 reviews on Google back up the food truck, with the ribs and the rib sandwich as the most requested items on the menu.

texto.es: Revisa nuestra ficha de Google o llamanos para saber donde esta Pop's Food Bus hoy.
texto.en: Check our Google listing or give us a call to see where Pop's Food Bus is parked today.

texto.es: Acercate a la ventanilla y elige tus costillas, sandwich o plato combinado.
texto.en: Step up to the window and choose your ribs, sandwich or combo plate.

texto.es: Todo se ahuma a fuego lento al momento, asi que espera unos minutos mientras se cocina bien.
texto.en: Everything is smoked low and slow to order, so plan for a short wait while it cooks right.

texto.es: Toma tu plato, busca donde sentarte cerca y disfruta el BBQ favorito de Fort Lauderdale.
texto.en: Grab your plate, find a spot nearby, and enjoy Fort Lauderdale's favorite BBQ truck.

nota.es: El menu cambia segun el dia. Llama antes para confirmar disponibilidad y precio.
nota.en: The menu can vary by day. Call ahead to confirm availability and pricing.

texto.es: Costillas ahumadas a fuego lento y terminadas con la salsa BBQ de mostaza de Pop's, el plato por el que los clientes regresan.
texto.en: Slow-smoked ribs finished with Pop's tangy mustard BBQ sauce, the dish customers keep coming back for.

texto.es: Carne de costilla ahumada apilada en pan blanco suave con queso derretido y salsa de mostaza.
texto.en: Tender smoked rib meat piled high on soft white bread with melted cheese and mustard sauce.

texto.es: Costillas servidas con acompanantes clasicos del sur como mac and cheese, collard greens y ensalada de papa.
texto.en: Ribs served with classic Southern sides like mac and cheese, collard greens and potato salad.

texto.es: Flavor wings y alitas de pavo fritas directo del camion, ideales para compartir mientras llegan las costillas.
texto.en: Flavor wings and fried turkey wings straight off the truck, great to share while your ribs are coming up.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos y te confirmamos que hay disponible hoy.
pie.en: Don't see exactly what you want? Call us and we will confirm what's available today.

items.quote: My family and I love the ribs from this place. I have not tried the other items on the menu but the ribs keep me coming back. It is not the cheapest, however, it is a small business and taste is worth it. You must try them!
Loved the rib sandwiches. Just right for me. The meat is so soft, I don't even need teeth. Great spot to visit on a Friday or Saturday.
Service and workers are beyond friendly.
